evidence.title: Confidence decay defaults
evidence.content: The default uniform decay rate is 10 percent confidence loss per month. Memories whose decayed confidence falls below the 0.2 prune floor are dropped during prune sweeps.

evidence.title: URL allowlist constraint
evidence.content: A byte-trie of allowed URLs is attached to the sampler. When the cursor is mid-URL at a non-terminal trie node, candidate tokens whose bytes would extend into an off-trie path get logit-clamped to negative infinity. EOS at non-terminal also masks so the model cannot terminate mid-URL.
